description: This file sets up and tests the 'exclude_patterns' functionality in a Git reference store using shell scripting. It defines functions to manipulate and verify reference data, performs a series of tests for different scenarios involving ref exclusions, and outputs the test results.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs the 'for-each-ref' command with exclusion patterns and processes the output.

methods.name: for_each_ref
methods.description: Fetches references with specified patterns in a formatted output.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks whether the number of ref jumps matches the expected count based on trace output.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Verifies that no ref jumps occurred during the trace, indicating no exclusions.
